p: From open-source commerce and early AI head-up displays with SKULLY in 2014, through Techstars ’17 and over $1B in venture-backed client revenue, to 1,600+ repositories and sovereign intelligence today.

Building business software since 2014, with AI and machine learning in commercial use from the start and GPT models in production by 2019. Founded as Crowdstart and renamed Hanzo in 2016. The first customer, SKULLY, raised $1M in about 45 hours, the fastest fully funded campaign on Indiegogo.
The first blockchain-native commerce platform, 2017: the Unikrn ICO raised over 120,000 ETH across regulated jurisdictions.
Damon Motorcycles and Triller, two of the companies Hanzo built with, listed on Nasdaq in 2024.
Hundreds of venture-funded startups, backed by Y Combinator, 500 Startups, Techstars and other tier-1 firms: billions in client revenue, and two companies taken past 100 million users.
Selected for Techstars in 2017 to build intelligent commerce: analytics, marketing and commerce on one learning engine.
Open-source from the start: hanzoai/commerce in 2014, followed by 1700+ public repositories across C/CUDA/Metal runtimes, MCP servers, agent SDKs, and HIP standards.
Built with hundreds of venture-funded startups: billions in client revenue and two that went public on Nasdaq in 2024, from our first customer SKULLY to the sovereign AI cloud today.
